notes: Twitch now uses this app's own registration, with browser sign-in, clear code instructions and automatic login renewal. No .env.local or client secret is required.
Fixed hover animations and Open preview playback across all overlay templates; previews keep playing during status updates and celebrations replay reliably.
Set both the default and minimum window width to 1000 pixels.
Reviewed credentials, authentication and updater security; excluded local test helpers and added Twitch checks before release publication.
